page.layout: One page of text in italic verse, 12 lines, with a woodcut ornament below the text. Running head at top, page number at top right.

l.i: Accipere accisis donec gens perfida rebus,
Te tremat, & iurata cohors te exhorreat unum,
Henrico prolem, atque in publica commoda
forte Concilium largire Deus, victósque videre
Regni hostes, sociásque urbes, domitósque rebelles:
Ut tibi mox victor meritis pro talibus ipse,
Et proceres regni grates, & vota rependant
Fac Deus, Henrico ut regi patriaque parenti
Lex praesit, Rex inde gregi, Tuque omnibus unus.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text (a cornucopia-like design with a head at the centre and foliage) is not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "iurata" is set with a consonant i and is given as printed; the initial letter of "Accipere" is a decorative capital; "Tuque" may carry an accent over the u, which is not clear on the scan. The running head is printed in spaced capitals with V for vowel u.
